source_publication.title: Structure and evolution-guided design of minimal RNA-guided nucleases

reference_comparator.name: wild-type TnpB reference used by the study

assays.assay_scope: Functional editing activity reported for generated SynTnpB candidates in the study's bacterial test context.
assays.comparator: wild-type TnpB reference used by the study
limitations: The public abstract does not establish an independent biological N for this audit.
Candidate-level failures and the complete screened denominator are not reconstructed here.
This assay does not compare SynTnpB with all Cas9 or Cas12 editors.

assays.assay_scope: Selected SynTnpB candidates were assessed for editing activity in a plant-cell system.
assays.comparator: wild-type TnpB reference used by the study
limitations: Cell-system activity is not field performance or agricultural readiness.
Delivery, ecological impact, durability, and independent replication are not established by this audit.
The comparison remains bounded to the study's named TnpB reference and test conditions.

assays.assay_scope: Selected SynTnpB candidates were assessed for editing activity in a human-cell system.
assays.comparator: wild-type TnpB reference used by the study
limitations: Activity in human cells is not in-vivo efficacy, clinical safety, or therapeutic benefit.
Off-target superiority, delivery, immunogenicity, toxicity, and durability are not established by this audit.
The comparison does not establish universal superiority over Cas9 or Cas12.

assays.assay_scope: Cryo-EM characterization of a selected divergent active SynTnpB variant across reported conformational states.
assays.comparator: structural interpretation within the selected SynTnpB case
limitations: A selected structure does not characterize all generated or screened candidates.
Observed contacts support a structural explanation, not clinical safety or broad causal superiority.
The selected variant is subject to winner-selection context.

claim_audit.statement: The hybrid AI and evolution-guided strategy generated divergent TnpB sequences that produced active RNA-guided nucleases after laboratory construction and screening.
limitations: The AI proposed sequences; laboratories created and experimentally tested the physical molecules.
The complete generation-to-failure denominator is not reconstructed in this preview audit.
Activity is bounded to the reported systems and assays.

claim_audit.statement: Some selected SynTnpB variants retained or exceeded the activity of the study's wild-type TnpB reference in tested cellular systems.
limitations: The comparator is the study's wild-type TnpB reference, not every natural nuclease.
Performance may be target-, assay-, cell-system-, and variant-dependent.
Editing activity alone does not establish specificity, safety, delivery, or therapeutic utility.

claim_audit.statement: Cryo-EM of a selected divergent active variant revealed stabilizing contacts at reported RNA and DNA interfaces.
limitations: The structure concerns a selected active variant rather than the entire generated library.
Structural contacts do not independently identify the complete functional mechanism.
The observation does not establish safety or clinical superiority.

claim_audit.statement: The SynTnpB design strategy generalizes reliably across targets, laboratories, delivery systems, and populations.
limitations: Independent replication is not established in this audit.
Broad target and delivery generalization require additional evidence.
The reported cellular systems do not constitute population-level validation.

claim_audit.statement: SynTnpB universally outperforms Cas9, Cas12, and natural gene editors.
limitations: The reported comparator is a wild-type TnpB reference.
No universal cross-editor benchmark is established by this record.
Activity in selected assays cannot support an all-context superiority claim.

claim_audit.statement: SynTnpB is clinically safe in humans.
limitations: Human-cell activity is not clinical safety.
In-vivo toxicity, immunogenicity, delivery, durability, and comprehensive off-target risk are outside the supported record.
No clinical authorization follows from this audit.
Molecular editing activity is not treatment efficacy.
No patient-level or therapeutic-outcome evidence is represented here.
Clinical claims remain blocked.

claim_audit.statement: SynTnpB is ready for agricultural deployment.
limitations: Plant-cell activity is not field performance or ecological safety.
Regulatory, containment, durability, and environmental evidence are not established.
Field use is not authorized.

claim_audit.statement: The SynTnpB findings have been independently replicated by an unrelated laboratory.
limitations: This audit records the originating collaboration's publication.
No unrelated-laboratory replication is accepted in the current record.
Publication and peer review do not themselves equal independent replication.

claim_audit.statement: The AI autonomously created and experimentally validated the gene editor without human scientific work.
limitations: Humans selected constraints, constructed molecules, ran screens, interpreted results, and performed structural work.
The model role was sequence proposal within a human-designed pipeline.
Attribution must preserve the full human and experimental chain.

claim_audit.statement: This audit authorizes synthesis, testing, deployment, or use of SynTnpB systems.
limitations: BioEvidence OS is computational and documentary only.
No sequences, procedures, delivery methods, concentrations, or optimization instructions are included.
Physical work requires institution-owned scientific, biosafety, ethical, legal, and regulatory governance.

mechanism_evidence.scope: Selected divergent active SynTnpB variant with reported RNA and DNA interface contacts across structural states.

next_valid_action: Obtain the full article and supplementary methods for denominator reconstruction, comparator-specific target tables, biological-unit accounting, off-target evidence mapping, and independent-replication search without adding physical experimental instructions.

safety_status.notes: This record audits evidence and claim scope only. It does not authorize or instruct biological modification.
